subject: Visibility modules consolidation request and commercial summary
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Cohen <arielle.cohen@brightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility modules consolidation request and commercial summary

Hi Arielle —

Thanks again for the time this week. Per our call I wanted to put a concise commercial summary on the table so your procurement and engineering teams can align. The goal here is to simplify Brightline's observability stack into one consolidated add-on with predictable billing and a single retention policy that maps to your compliance needs. High level: 

- Scope: retention for traces (full trace storage + sampling tier), long-term log retention for 90/365 day buckets, and an advanced dashboards bundle (up to 25 seats).
- Pricing model: blended usage + seat commitment. We recommend a 12-month committed spend to enable the 18% consolidation discount below.
- Proposed economics (illustrative):
  * Retention: $0.004 per GB-month for 90-day, $0.0028 per GB-month for archival 365-day
  * Tracing: $0.12 per active trace (sampled) + seat fee for 25 dashboard seats ($200/seat/mo)
  * Consolidation discount: 18% off list for a 12-month commit or 12% for 6 months

Attachments: Redwood_Visibility_Proposal_v2.pdf (summary pricing, retention mapping, SLA appendix).

Asks: can you confirm the following so we can pin the proposal for procurement?
1) Target commit horizon (6 vs 12 months)
2) Expected average daily ingest (GB/day) for telemetry we should model against
3) Any mandated PII redaction or retention hold requirements for Brightline records

If this looks directionally right I’ll follow up with a formal SOW and a worked example invoice at two scale points (pilot vs 3x growth).

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Visibility_Proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 342KB)]

From: Arielle Cohen <arielle.cohen@brightline.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility modules consolidation request and commercial summary

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from my side and I'll loop in procurement: 

- We are evaluating a 12-month commit but need the pilot month (first month) to be cancellable if ingest is >2x baseline. Any early-exit language?
- Can you map the "25 seats" to our user roles? We have ~6 SREs who need full trace debugging access, ~10 PM/Analytics who need dashboards only, and ~9 product managers with read-only access. Does Redwood tier seats by role?
- On compliance: we have a strict PII posture. Can Redwood confirm the retention buckets support selective retention (i.e., strip PII from long-term archives but retain it in short-term for debugging)? If not, we need to understand encryption + KMS options.

Also — procurement asked for a one-page total cost at two utilization points (Pilot: 4TB/month ingest; Growth: 18TB/month ingest) and the proposed discount tiers. If you can get me that by Monday that would be perfect.

Thanks,
Arielle Cohen
Director, Infrastructure & Observability — Brightline

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 09:12 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Visibility modules consolidation request and commercial summary

Ben / Kim —

Forwarding Arielle's clarification requests. Key asks from Brightline: 12-month commit preference (with a cancellable pilot month if ingest >2x baseline), seat-role breakdown, and selective PII retention / KMS details. Procurement needs a one-page cost summary at 4TB and 18TB scenarios.

My suggested concessions to close the deal this quarter: 
- Offer the 12-month commitment with an 18% consolidation discount but allow a 30-day pilot exit if ingest >2x baseline (we can define a burn rate clause).
- Seat packaging: propose Role-based seat tiers — Full Debug (SRE) seats count as 1.5x against the 25-seat bundle; Viewer seats (PM/Product) count as 0.6x. This preserves pricing while matching usage.
- PII / KMS: provide selective retention by default (field-level redaction for long-term buckets) and provide KMS integration for enterprise customers with a small one-time configuration fee.

Do we have authority to offer 18%? If not, what's the maximum concession we can give without escalating? Also need sign-off on the pilot exit language (legal to confirm).

Thanks,
Rafael

> On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 11:05 AM Arielle Cohen <arielle.cohen@brightline.com> wrote:
> > (external reply omitted)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Cohen <arielle.cohen@brightline.com>, procurement@brightline.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility modules consolidation request and commercial summary

Hi Arielle —

Thanks for the fast follow. Attached is a one-page worked example and an updated SOW (SOW_Visibility_Tracing_Appendix.xlsx) — short answers to your bullets below, then next steps: 

1) Pilot exit / early-exit: we can include a one-month pilot waiver for ingest >2x baseline. If the trigger fires we will prorate and refund the non-used committed funds for the pilot month only. Legal will add a short definitional clause to the SOW.

2) Seat mapping: we can implement role-based multipliers as discussed. For Brightline the pricing in the one-pager assumes: 6 SREs = 9 FullDebug equivalents, 10 PM/Analytics = 6 Viewer equivalents, 9 PM read-only = 5.4 Viewer equivalents — total bundle consumption shown on the one-pager. If you prefer a strict role separation we can also invoice three seat types separately.

3) PII retention / KMS: Redwood supports field-level redaction on archival buckets and integrates with customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). We will include a SOC 2 appendix and the KMS integration checklist as part of the SOW.

Commercial: for a 12-month committed contract we are prepared to offer an 18% consolidation discount across the visibility bundle (retention + tracing + dashboards). Example TCO (summary):
- Pilot (4TB/mo): Estimated monthly charge after discount = $19,800
- Growth (18TB/mo): Estimated monthly charge after discount = $69,600

Next steps: 
- Procurement: confirm PO cadence and preferred contract template (we can accept Brightline's template or propose Redwood's).
- Engineering: schedule a 30-minute call next week to walk the SREs through the retention mapping and KMS setup. Suggested times: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

If this aligns I’ll circulate the final SOW and a redline-ready contract.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Visibility_Tracing_Appendix.xlsx (XLSX, 128KB)]
